summary: This video showcases a full Toxin element team fighting Level 300 Queen of Blasphemy (Area Boss 4) in the Crisis Rally event. The lineup consisting of Serpentemis, Sleight, Reytah, Sacredeia, and Twitch reached S-rank with a total damage score of 4,853,169,208. Sacredeia and Reytah dominated the damage charts, producing over 2.0 billion and 1.75 billion damage respectively. Full equipment, stats, and artifact loadouts for all five heroes are displayed at the end of the run.
